robot.name: AgiBot G2
robot.generation: Successor to the G1 platform; industrial wheeled humanoid under Genie sub-brand
robot.status_notes: AgiBot product page and PR Newswire describe commercial/industrial availability. PR Newswire (June 28, 2026) says the 15,000th robot is an AgiBot G2 and that G2 units operate in a Longcheer Technology mass-production line. Robotic Gizmos reports integration into Longcheer's line with 310 UPH and 99% success. No public price or online purchase path; contact sales only.

height.notes: No height published in any used source. 9S Robotics table lists height as '—' and says detailed hardware specifications are pending official publication.

weight.notes: No weight published in any used source.

payload.notes: No payload spec found. 9S Robotics table lists payload as '—'.

runtime.notes: Interesting Engineering states dual hot-swappable batteries for 24/7 industrial use and continuous around-the-clock operation with autonomous recharging. No single-battery runtime in hours was provided.

battery.notes: Dual hot-swappable batteries; capacity not published. PR Newswire mentions 15,000th unit but no battery spec.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: 26-DoF body with 7-DoF force-controlled arms and 5-DOF waist-leg structure (per Interesting Engineering). Catalog record also lists 26 DoF body with 7 DoF force-controlled arms. Total body DoF treated as 26, but the arms may be additional.

walking_speed.notes: Wheeled base with four-wheel steering and omnidirectional mobility (crab-walking, zero-radius rotation). No linear speed in m/s published.

hands.description: OmniHand (professional version) dexterous, tactile hand for logistics sorting; described as high-degree-of-freedom dexterous tactile hand.
hands.force_feedback: dual-arm force control with 0.5 newtons of force (company claim)

compute.description: NVIDIA Jetson Thor, up to 2,070 TFLOPS.

actuators.description: Force-controlled arms with 0.5 N force and submillimeter accuracy; four-wheel steering; 5-DOF waist-leg structure; 100% automotive-grade components.

availability.notes: No public price. Product page has contact-sales form. 9S Robotics lists Price (USD) as '—'.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: Company demos show seatbelt lock cylinder assembly, material handling, RAM insertion within an hour, and OmniHand gripping parcels of varying sizes, shapes and materials. Longcheer line reports picking tablets and sorting defective/finished products with up to 310 UPH and 99% success (per Robotic Gizmos).
caveats: No independent dexterity benchmark or success-rate verification.
Longcheer numbers are from a secondary blog citing a video; not audited.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: AgiBot says G2 runs 24/7 with autonomous navigation and auto-return charging. Logistics demo used autonomous navigation adapting to more than 95% of factory floor conditions. Robotic Gizmos claims autonomous 24/7 operation with 99% success. PR Newswire reports approximately 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations on a tablet quality inspection section.
caveats: Autonomy claims are company-asserted or secondary; no intervention logs or independent audit.
Teleoperation not always disclosed; low-latency teleoperation is a designed feature.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Wheeled base with four-wheel steering, omnidirectional movement including crab-walking and zero-radius rotation; 5-DOF waist-leg structure provides human-like upper-body movement. No walking.
caveats: Wheeled, not legged; no speed, stability or disturbance-recovery metrics.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: 360-degree surround-view sensing, high-precision collision detection, eye-gaze tracking; navigation adapts to more than 95% of factory floor conditions in logistics demo.
caveats: No detailed sensor suite or independent perception benchmarks.
360-degree sensing is a company claim.

human_interaction.summary: Supports multi-user conversation, expressive facial animations, human-like movements, eye-gaze tracking, and guided tours with customized knowledge base and human-like body language.
caveats: Interaction demos not independently verified; no conversational reliability metrics.
Guided-tour demo was part of launch event.

endurance_reliability.summary: Dual hot-swappable batteries for 24/7 use; passed more than 130 component tests including temperatures from -15°C to 50°C, electrostatic protection and emergency braking; PR Newswire reports approximately 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations.
caveats: Company-reported tests; no independent mean time between failures.
Livestream details limited; no intervention counts.

human_environment_fit.summary: IP42 protection, 100% automotive-grade components, hybrid active-passive safety architecture, collision detection; designed for factory and public environments.
caveats: IP42 is not full dust/water protection.
No third-party safety certification found.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Named deployment on Longcheer Technology production line. PR Newswire says the 15,000th robot is AgiBot G2 and Longcheer GM attended ceremony. Robotic Gizmos reports integration in 36 hours with 310 UPH and 99% success.
caveats: Deployment details from AgiBot or secondary media; no customer press release or audited output metrics.
15,000th unit is a production milestone, not Longcheer fleet size.

accessibility_value.summary: No public price; product page offers contact sales form.
caveats: Not purchasable online; pricing unknown.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: AgiBot G2 is an industrial wheeled humanoid with strong commercial deployment evidence (Longcheer production line, 15,000th unit milestone) and company-reported operational data (approx. 100 hours livestream, 310 UPH). However most specs are missing and performance numbers are not independently audited.
strongest_positive_evidence: Named deployment on Longcheer's mass-production line (Robotic Gizmos and PR Newswire).
Approximately 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations per PR Newswire.
15,000th robot rolled off production line is AgiBot G2.
Launch demos show RAM insertion, logistics sorting with >95% floor adaptation.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No height, weight, payload, battery capacity, hand DoF or speed.
No independent verification of 310 UPH or 99% success.
No public price or purchase path.
Teleoperation not disclosed for most demos.
conflicting_claims: Total DoF: 26 body + 7 arms per IE; catalog record says 26 DoF body with 7 DoF force-controlled arms. Treat body DoF=26, arms additional.
Runtime: IE says 24/7 with hot-swappable batteries but no single-battery hours; do not infer a continuous numeric runtime.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit bipedal walking; G2 is wheeled.
Do not treat 310 UPH or 99% success as independently verified.
Do not infer missing specs from directories.
Do not assume all demos are autonomous; only logistics demo explicitly says autonomous.

currentness.currentness_notes: As of 2026-10-29, G2 is current in AgiBot's commercial lineup. PR Newswire June 2026 names G2 as milestone production unit.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: AgiBot G2 is an industrial wheeled humanoid (26-DoF body, 7-DoF force-controlled arms, 5-DOF waist-leg, four-wheel steering) powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor (up to 2,070 TFLOPS). It is IP42-rated with automotive-grade components and dual hot-swappable batteries for 24/7 use. Strongest evidence includes a named deployment on Longcheer's mass-production line, a company-reported 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations, and the 15,000th AgiBot robot being a G2. Launch demos show RAM insertion, logistics sorting with >95% floor adaptation, and guided tours. However height, weight, payload, battery capacity and price are missing, and deployment metrics (310 UPH, 99% success) come from secondary media without independent audit.
strongest_evidence: Named deployment on Longcheer production line (Robotic Gizmos, PR Newswire).
Approximately 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations (PR Newswire).
15,000th robot production milestone is an AgiBot G2 (PR Newswire).
Launch demo: autonomous navigation adapting to >95% factory floor conditions (Interesting Engineering).
weakest_evidence: No height, weight, payload, battery capacity or price published.
310 UPH and 99% success only from secondary blog.
Teleoperation not disclosed for most demos.
known_do_not_credit: All demos as autonomous except where explicitly stated.
